description: Defines the MPSEvent class and MPSEventPool class for managing GPU events in Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) framework, including event recording, waiting, notification, and timing functionalities.

classes.name: MPSEvent
classes.description: Represents a GPU event for synchronization and timing in MPS.

classes.name: MPSEventPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of MPSEvent objects for reuse and efficient event handling.

methods.name: MPSEvent::record
methods.description: Records an event on the associated stream.

methods.name: MPSEvent::wait
methods.description: Blocks until the event is signaled.

methods.name: MPSEvent::notify
methods.description: Schedules a callback for when the event occurs.

methods.name: MPSEvent::query
methods.description: Checks if the event has been signaled.

methods.name: MPSEvent::synchronize
methods.description: Blocks until all GPU work before the event is completed.

methods.name: MPSEvent::reset
methods.description: Resets the event with new parameters for reuse.

methods.name: MPSEventPool::acquireEvent
methods.description: Acquires an event from the pool.

methods.name: MPSEventPool::releaseEvent
methods.description: Releases an event back to the pool.

methods.name: MPSEventPool::recordEvent
methods.description: Records an event with specified timing.

methods.name: MPSEventPool::waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event to complete.

methods.name: MPSEventPool::queryEvent
methods.description: Queries the status of a specific event.

methods.name: MPSEventPool::elapsedTime
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time between two events.
